content: Sync-status endpoint convention: GET /sync or /sync/:id returning status/syncing_at/completed_at/failed_at/error, plus a modified_after-style cursor so clients pull only changed records since last sync. Best practice is polling-as-source-of-truth with webhooks as a fast-path optimization, never webhook-only, because webhooks can silently fail; a periodic poll (or manual 'resync' trigger) is the backstop that guarantees eventual consistency. Directly supports the project's 'reconciliation status queryable, first thing any client renders' requirement. Source: Merge.dev docs, general sync-architecture blogs (MEDIUM).
